title: Yellow Dense Malaysian Chicken Noodles
description: A citrusy and dense Malaysian dish featuring gouda cheese and render-fat, perfect for a post-workout meal, and is FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Heat the render-fat in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the malaysian curry powder to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Add the rice noodles to the skillet and cook according to package instructions.
Stir in the gouda cheese until melted and well combined.
Add the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodle mixture.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving platter and top with chopped green onions.
